2026-07-29 12:46:02.092531 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-07-29 12:46:02.092571 | controller |
2026-07-29 12:46:02.092580 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-29 12:46:02.092594 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-29 12:46:02.092601 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-29 12:46:02.092608 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-29 12:46:02.092615 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
